title: Steel Surface Cleaning Before Painting | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Clean steel holds paint longer. Steel Mind Engineers removes mill scale, rust, oil and weld spatter from every part before coating, for projects across Pakistan.
h1: Steel Surface Cleaning in Pakistan: Preparing Steel for a Coating That Lasts
quickAnswer: Cleaning is the step between fabrication and painting. Steel Mind Engineers removes mill scale, rust, oil, grease and weld spatter so that the coating bonds to bare steel and lasts longer.
alt: Worker preparing a steel beam surface before painting at the Steel Mind Engineers factory.

faq.q: Why is cleaning needed if the steel is new?
faq.a: New steel carries mill scale and light rust. Paint on top of them peels early.

faq.q: Is cleaning done again on site?
faq.a: Only where parts are damaged or welded on site. Those areas are cleaned before touch-up.

blocks.text: Paint does not hold well on dirty steel. Mill scale, rust, oil and dust form a weak layer between the steel and the coating. The paint then lifts, blisters or peels. Good cleaning costs little compared with repainting a building.

bullets: Mill scale, the hard grey layer that forms on new steel.
Oil and grease, from machines and handling.
Weld spatter and sharp edges, which prevent an even coat.

blocks.text: The cleaning method follows the coating system. A building for a dry indoor use needs a different surface than a bridge, a tank or a dairy shed that faces moisture. The engineer sets the surface requirement when the coating system is chosen. See Painting.

Cleaning takes place in the factory after welding and before the first coat. Painting follows soon after, so that the clean steel does not rust again. Areas that are damaged in transport or erection are cleaned again before touch-up.
Ask to see the parts before the primer coat. The steel should look clean, dry and free of loose rust, oil and spatter.
